selection: Next two available Dataset2 subjects in numeric order after subject1; fixed before their video/HR outcomes
retain_subject1: Report separately as previously inspected, ROI-assisted

protocol.selection: First accessible subject in numeric order, starting subject1; do not choose using measured HR error
protocol.scope: initial independent-recording feasibility check, not population validation
protocol.primary_reference: dominant frequency of synchronized contact PPG in each identical 30-second window; fixed same Welch and band
protocol.quality: ratio_threshold 1.2; separation .15Hz; edge margin .05Hz; no fitting
protocol.error_event_for_exploratory_flag_table: absolute HR difference >5 BPM; threshold fixed before external outcome
protocol.report: all windows, failures, coverage and error; no post hoc threshold changes
protocol.protocol_amendment_before_signal_access: Dataset authors readme says they evaluate contact-PPG-derived HR, not sensor HR. Amended before downloading/inspecting any subject waveform or video.

automatic_policy: Original strict Haar/LK first; count failures; no silent subject replacement
assistance_policy: If needed, explicit separate manual-target-region fallback, using only geometry before HR outcomes. Do not mix with automatic successes.
identity_plan: SFace CPU if reliable. Small within-dataset linkability demonstration only, temporal split enrollment/probes; not independent-session anonymity validation.

detector_variant_before_new_outcomes.name: YuNet per-frame automatic
detector_variant_before_new_outcomes.policy: Run strict Haar/LK and separate YuNet automatic variant on both new recordings, without manual assistance; preserve every failure. Set before reading new-video HR results.
